title: WITTY INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL
comments: 0 class comments
full_text:
WITTY INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL

JANMASHTAMI CELEBRATION 🪈🦚

Date of Celebration: Wednesday, 2nd September 2026

Dearr Parents,

Greetings of the day! Jai Shri Krishna!

The joyous festival of Janmashtami is here, and we are delighted to celebrate this special occasion with our students on Wednesday, 2nd September 2026.

To make the day colourful and memorable, we warmly invite our little ones to come dressed as *Radha or Krishna*, adding to the festive spirit with their traditional attire, peacock feathers and flutes.

To ensure that the children have a comfortable and enjoyable day, we kindly request parents to take note of a few arrangements:

* It will be a *No Bag Day*, so students need not carry their regular school bags.


* Parents are requested to kindly send only their child’s *lunch and stationery pouch*.


* While we celebrate this special occasion, *regular classroom learning will continue as scheduled*, supported by engaging worksheet-based activities.


* The children will also participate in *age-appropriate festive activities, devotional songs and joyful celebrations* that bring alive the spirit of Janmashtami.

We sincerely appreciate your support and cooperation in making the celebration meaningful and enjoyable for our children.

We look forward to a beautiful day filled with *joy, devotion, togetherness and the cheerful smiles of our little Radhas and Krishnas*.

May Lord Krishna’s blessings bring happiness, peace and prosperity to every family.

*Wishing you and your family a very Happy and Blessed Janmashtami! 🙏*

Warm regards,
Witty International School

Dear Parents,

Important Reminder

* Prefect Selections will be held on 12th June 2026.
Prefects are student leaders who help teachers and set a positive example for others.

* Students who are interested can nominate themselves for the role of prefect. The final selection will be done through a student voting process, where classmates will vote for the nominated candidates.

* Students must be present in school on that day. Only those present will be considered, as the selection process will be conducted only once.

* The Prefect tenure will be for the entire academic year.

* The Class Monitor System will also begin on 12th June 2026.
   Class monitors help in managing simple classroom responsibilities and supporting the teacher.

* Monitors will be appointed on a roll number-wise rotational basis to ensure fair opportunities for all students.

* The first monitor term will be from 12th June to 20th June 2026.

* Selected monitors will be given a monitor badge and will be responsible for its safekeeping.

* In case of loss or damage to the badge, the replacement cost will need to be borne by parents.

* The duration of a monitor’s term may vary due to holidays, examinations, vacations, or other school schedules.

We request your cooperation and support in encouraging your child to take up these responsibilities with enthusiasm.

Regards,
Team Witty
